description: This file defines a custom logging handler class LokiHTTPHandler which sends log records to a Loki logging server via an HTTP API. It includes methods for initializing the handler with configuration parameters and for emitting logs encoded in JSON format, including timestamp and labels.

classes.description: A logging.Handler subclass that sends log records to Loki via HTTP push API.
